current_grouping: 20. AERIAL DELIVERY: AIR TRANSPORT AND AIRDROP

versions.grouping_at_time: 20. AERIAL DELIVERY: AIR TRANSPORT AND AIRDROP
versions.text:
Standard: Air vehicle cargo and payload loading and airdrop manuals provide all procedures necessary for aerial delivery. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
(1) Perform ground demonstration to verify cargo and payload loading and airdrop manuals provide the level of instruction that permits crewmembers to transport and air drop cargo without damage to the air vehicle.
